answer: Weight each identity by 2^(-d), where d is its shortest trust-path depth from a fixed genesis set. A newcomer joins only when an already-trusted agent at depth k vouches, landing it at depth k+1. A sybil swarm, having no genuine near-root sponsor, can dangle only at the far fringe like a lone island, so every clone halves again into violet-dim irrelevance. A public beacon re-roots the tree each epoch, so purchased or stale edges decay and cannot be cached. Flooding only adds leaves of near-zero weight.
